dataset_info.name: Comprehensive Document Intent Classification Dataset
dataset_info.description: Multi-domain dataset mapping document semantics, long-range objectives, and contextual goals to distinct intent categories.

Product Return & Refund Request.description: User wants to return a purchased product or service and receive a full or partial refund/reimbursement.
sample_phrases: I believe returning the product and receiving the appropriate refund is the most practical way to achieve that.
I would rather return the item through the proper procedure and have the amount I paid handled according to the applicable policy.
Please initiate the return process and issue a complete refund for this defective product.
Product Return & Refund Request.simple_reason: The author wants to return the item and receive a full refund because the product failed to meet expectations despite troubleshooting.

Academic & Institutional Grievance.description: User is raising formal complaints and grievances regarding college/school management, strict rules, teacher competence, or academic policies.
sample_phrases: There are too many strict rules and teachers do not teach properly.
The management charges huge fees but Saturday classes are a waste of time and teachers don't know basic coding.
Please take the opinion of students into consideration regarding college policies.
Academic & Institutional Grievance.simple_reason: The author is lodging a serious grievance against institutional policies, administrative restrictions, and teaching quality.

Product Defect & Quality Complaint.description: User is lodging a complaint specifically focusing on a broken, damaged, or poor quality physical or digital product.
sample_phrases: The item arrived broken and defective right out of the box.
The build quality is completely unacceptable and broke during normal use.
Product Defect & Quality Complaint.simple_reason: The author is formally complaining about severe physical or operational product defects and poor quality.

Technical Support & Troubleshooting.description: User is currently experiencing an unresolved software/hardware bug and actively seeking technical troubleshooting assistance.
sample_phrases: The software crashes immediately with error code 0x80004005 upon startup.
I need help configuring my network settings to connect properly.
Technical Support & Troubleshooting.simple_reason: The author is facing a technical error or software issue and requires technical assistance.

Service Cancellation & Account Terminati.description: User wants to immediately cancel their recurring subscription, membership, or account service.
sample_phrases: I want to cancel my annual subscription and close my account immediately.
Please ensure auto-renewal is disabled and terminate my membership.
Service Cancellation & Account Terminati.simple_reason: The author is requesting the immediate termination of their account and cancellation of recurring services.

Billing & Payment Dispute.description: User is disputing an incorrect charge, unrecognized payment, or erroneous invoice.
sample_phrases: I was charged twice on my credit card statement for the same order.
There is an unexpected hidden fee on my latest billing invoice.
Billing & Payment Dispute.simple_reason: The author is disputing an erroneous charge and seeking an immediate billing correction.

Legal Dispute & Contract Notice.description: User is citing statutory rights, contract terms, or formally notifying of impending legal arbitration.
sample_phrases: This is a formal notice of contract breach prior to escalating to legal litigation.
My attorney will contact your legal department if damages are not settled.
Legal Dispute & Contract Notice.simple_reason: The author is notifying of a legal dispute and reserving rights for formal legal action.

Medical & Health Inquiry.description: User is describing health symptoms or clinical issues and seeking medical advice or care.
sample_phrases: I am experiencing persistent pain and need guidance on medication dosage.
What are the clinical recommendations for managing these symptoms?
Medical & Health Inquiry.simple_reason: The author is asking for medical advice and clinical clarification regarding symptoms.

Workplace & Employment Grievance.description: User is reporting workplace conditions, managerial unfairness, compensation issues, or HR grievances.
sample_phrases: I am writing regarding unpaid overtime hours and toxic working conditions.
Management has failed to address safety and compensation issues in our department.
Workplace & Employment Grievance.simple_reason: The author is raising a formal workplace grievance regarding management, compensation, or conditions.

Feature Request & Product Feedback.description: User is offering constructive ideas, UX suggestions, or feature requests to improve a product.
sample_phrases: I really like the application and suggest adding a batch export feature in the next update.
It would greatly improve user experience if you introduced customizable themes.
Feature Request & Product Feedback.simple_reason: The author is providing constructive feedback and suggestions for future product improvements.

Order Tracking & Delivery Status.description: User is asking for an update on shipping progress, delivery date, or consignment status.
sample_phrases: Where is my package? The tracking number shows no movement for a week.
Please provide the updated delivery date for order #48291.
Order Tracking & Delivery Status.simple_reason: The author is requesting real-time shipping and delivery status updates for their order.

General Information Inquiry.description: User is making a general informational inquiry seeking guidance, policy clarification, or answers.
sample_phrases: Could you provide more information regarding your terms of service?
I would like clarification on how the onboarding process works.
General Information Inquiry.simple_reason: The author is seeking information, guidance, or clarification on specific policies or procedures.
